facts.fact: 梦开：彩墨之城玻璃圣堂——六角星阵凿井（quintessence 浓集处「willing to be shared」）——献血入井、Descend/Ascend 双向阶梯（其下 blazing furnace）——他只是 passenger（Orsus/造界记忆）。
facts.anchor: He was a passenger in this dream,

facts.fact: 梦中洞穴：astralam 引至宝石洞——Taesia 持紫水晶——「I did what I had to.」「I wasn't going to kill the child. I wouldn't.」——这次在清醒头脑里的吻——「Wake up. Julian. Wake—」。
营地晨景：沙海一周程；帐篷分配（兄弟一顶/Julian+Fin+Edwin 一顶）；Edwin「good rest」纠语；Rian 夜半噩梦被听见；Edwin+Edwin 晨祷 Third Sun。
facts.anchor: Technically, there is no concept of night in Solara.

facts.fact: 早餐情报：Edwin 校图（漏一小聚落）；vern aquan 沙律（给水于敌、可后杀）；drakusel 象树储水；「We did not build the aqueducts. The talpascor did.」——沙下掘渠兽为真。
行路歌：Edwin 的 Sunslayer Saga 唱段——「shadows hungry as she crept, shadows hungry as she crept, till up the tower Aurora she leapt, to kiss cold sword to warm-blooded neck.」

双雄谈神：「Orsus did something with Varrick’s feather」「Orsus is using me. They wanted me to kill Phos when we were in Noctus, and I didn't. They want to make sure the job gets done this time.」——「Will Orsus want you to kill Taesia?」——「Even if they do, I won't let them.」
Nikolas 撕破：「I intend to fulfill my promise...What happens to her from that point on isn't my concern.」——贴额钳颈：「You love her, and it’s going to kill you...It's going to kill us all.」
facts.anchor: You love her, and it’s going to kill you.

facts.fact: 章末：骨镯转冰——远处 buzzing rage（兽群被鞭驱）——「And coming straight for them.」（talpascor 来袭）。
